question: What are the best things to do in Jaipur?
answer:
Here are some of the best things to do in Jaipur:

1. **Amber Palace**: A stunning blend of Hindu and Muslim architecture, this palace offers a unique experience, including elephant rides. [View on Maps](https://www.google.com/maps/place//data=!4m2!3m1!1s0x396db05acbd20dfb:0x6221df6747147e2b)

2. **Hawa Mahal**: Known as the "Palace of Winds," this striking castle was designed for royal ladies to observe street festivities without being seen. [View on Maps](https://www.google.com/maps/place//data=!4m2!3m1!1s0x396db14b1bd30ba5:0x860e5d531eccb20c)

3. **The City Palace**: This opulent 18th-century royal residence now serves as a museum showcasing the history of Jaipur. [View on Maps](https://www.google.com/maps/place//data=!4m2!3m1!1s0x396db40b8620b0c1:0x44801531017d7b60)

4. **Nahargarh Fort**: Perched in the hills, this fort offers panoramic views of the city and is a great spot for photography. [View on Maps](https://www.google.com/maps/place//data=!4m2!3m1!1s0x396db15cf347f3d1:0xaaaa6e617ae9e8b)

5. **Jaigarh Fort**: Known for its impressive architecture and views, this fort also features an on-site museum. [View on Maps](https://www.google.com/maps/place//data=!4m2!3m1!1s0x396db1b1b15f49c7:0xbc19c49ec4a15381)

6. **Jal Mahal**: This beautiful palace is located in the middle of Man Sagar Lake, with part of it submerged underwater. [View on Maps](https://www.google.com/maps/place//data=!4m2!3m1!1s0x396db11be9767295:0x97d34f11a313abd2)

7. **Sheesh Mahal, Amer Fort**: Famous for its intricate mirror work, this pavilion is a highlight of the Amber Fort complex. [View on Maps](https://www.google.com/maps/place//data=!4m2!3m1!1s0x396db17dbc3a7771:0x4f4a5a2ff62ec26d)

8. **Birla Mandir**: A modern Hindu temple made of white marble, featuring beautiful carvings and an on-site museum. [View on Maps](https://www.google.com/maps/place//data=!4m2!3m1!1s0x396db699af2ea7af:0x7d979cd62bdc8058)

9. **Chokhi Dhani - The Ethnic Village**: An upscale destination offering traditional Rajasthani cuisine and cultural performances. [View on Maps](https://www.google.com/maps/place//data=!4m2!3m1!1s0x396dc96e5f04f419:0x7987ca41bab6342a)

10. **Mouj Mahal**: A family-friendly destination with live performances and various activities suitable for all ages. [View on Maps](https://www.google.com/maps/place//data=!4m2!3m1!1s0x396db1f32e96dea3:0x712843991b720f9f)

These attractions offer a mix of history, culture, and stunning architecture, making Jaipur a fantastic destination to explore!
